systems.platform: phone and tablet app for recording road accidents and following victims
systems.owner: AGUISER (Agence guinéenne de la sécurité routière)
systems.tiers: police, gendarmerie, civil protection, health services

GIN.note: ADAMS Guinée is a digital accident-collection system; the document states no statistics published from administrative records and no statistics-office work on them.
ADAMS records road accidents only, a single function; it is not said to record stations' reports or cases.
